result.detail: Scenario-to-spec mapping: S0 reset with sources high (IRQ-RESET); S1 register read/write, masking of bits N and up, PENDING writes never set, ack with nothing pending (IRQ-REG-RW, IRQ-PARAM, IRQ-W1C, IRQ-ACK); S2 a disabled source still pends, enabling unmasks it, CLAIM format (IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED, IRQ-MASK, IRQ-CLAIM); S3 no combinational path from src to irq, and irq changes at the detection edge and at the ack edge (IRQ-LATENCY); S4 several requesters at once, a disabled lower source, ack number N or 31 changes nothing, ack uses only bits 4..0 (IRQ-PRIORITY, IRQ-ACK); S5 partial W1C patterns (IRQ-W1C); S6 a level source cleared while its input is high stays pending (IRQ-SET-WINS); S7 an edge source sets once while held, and a rising edge at the same edge as a clear wins (IRQ-EDGE, IRQ-SET-WINS); S8 a switch from level to edge mode while the input is held high creates no new edge, because the remembered level is tracked in both modes (IRQ-EDGE); S9 reset in mid-operation; S10 random traffic with occasional resets, checked against the model. The reference model is my own reading of the spec. A reviewer should confirm it independently rather than treat it as authoritative. The main residual risks are the plusarg name and simulator-specific SystemVerilog support, for example string-typed $value$plusargs and part-selects on int in Icarus.
